Hiccup grass is a forageable plant that grows naturally in the [[swamp]] area west of the [[graveyard]]. You need to repair the [[stone bridge]] in order to access it and then you can repair the [[swamp bridge]] from the west side for much easier access. You give this to the [[merchant]] to cure him from his hiccups. 

==Quest==

===Hiccup Cure===
The [[merchant]] is suffering from hiccups. After trying to scare the hiccups out of him, he gives you a quest to find {{Item|Hiccup grass|1}} growing in the [[swamp]], west of the [[church]] across the [[stone bridge]], which you have to repair. Return to the [[merchant]] for 10 {{Happiness}}.

==Alchemy==
Hiccup grass is decomposable into [[Health solution|solution]] with the [[hand mixer]]. Having unlocked the [[Anatomy and Alchemy (Tech Tree)|Master of Alchemy]] produces one additional reagent.
